full_details: In the morning you put the plot into two lines you could say aloud: four gentlemen, three years, no woman, and four ladies. At the Split Hazel Kemp told yesterday's hamper, the stool, the line, and the glove, and Alice kept his elbows off the gravy until she allowed the end. Then, in the same voice, he asked whether the Queen's twenty pounds had come. You said it is expected. She said expected money has eaten several dinners in this house and never paid for one. Kemp laughed loudest and paid for his own. You paid fourpence. You played in the Shrew and did not bring the part home as a story. Supper was threepence: salt ling, a penny loaf, small beer. The loaf was short of the notch by the width of a finger. She asked what Tuesday night's walking had been for. You told her the gentlemen and the ladies. She priced a play that begins in a broken oath at a pin. Verbeke asked whether the ladies are punished too. Alse asked who does the washing. You wrote washing on your tables. The cat was on your stool when you got up.
one_sentence: You paid fourpence at the Split Hazel, played in the Shrew, and came home to a loaf a finger short of the notch.
title: Paid fourpence and came home to a short loaf
